pr.body:
Phase 3 remains **NO-GO**. PR #59 must stay **DRAFT** and unmerged. No owner-data migration or later phase.

Latest durable source: `9545de698be9fcccd2e6f4aee70fd89fd0e885a7`, exact tree `91acfefa872fa93f2d24e70d712e8c18de17b64a`, parent `98642176dbec93d5721e66cbc19158110289d329`.

Current enrollment checkpoint moves original alias deletion outside its own monitor, preserves atomic installed-alias ownership and sticky original failure/Error outcomes for duplicate close, and rejects inherited-monitor/provider-reentrant close before side effects. The private completion future allocates before provider creation. Actual preceding-source 9/3 and intermediate inherited-monitor 1/1 failures are retained. Final frozen488 inputs passed 281 targeted, 932 debug JVM and939 Phase0 JVM tests with zero failures/errors/skips, both lints, four APK assemblies, packaged/static/mutation checks and independent scoped review. Nine new Android synthetic JCA/backend fixtures compile; final exact-head execution is pending (298 expected is not a pass). Cipher/provider/backend aliasLock, outer controller/request gates and complete attempt ownership remain pending.

This preceding buffer checkpoint binds the production 64 KiB manifest probe buffer to its exact guard/original/literal child. Borrowing is exclusive and Boolean-only; synchronous callbacks execute outside its private gate. Admitted failures clear actual bytes after callback unwind. Rejected borrowers cannot wipe active callbacks. Self-close denies before changing state; interrupted/failed disposal remains charged. Independent input/connection unblockers and all existing security negatives remain preserved.

Verification: actual nine-case preceding-source regression had three failures; corrected component group passed 51 cases. The frozen pre-marker test revision passed 197 targeted, 923 complete debug JVM and 930 complete Phase 0 JVM cases, both lints and all four APK assemblies. Independent review identified a test timeout ambiguity; the final test-only marker correction passed all 15 buffer cases separately in both JVM variants and rebuilt both Android test APKs. Production is unchanged across these revisions; evidence explicitly distinguishes them. Fresh packaged backup/model checks, all 14 SDK-configured backup mutation regressions, public vectors/design/browser/VPN/secret/legacy corpus checks passed. Scoped independent review has no remaining Critical/Important/Minor findings. Fifteen new ART cases compile; exact new-head CI/device execution is pending (289 expected cases is not a pass claim).

Preceding durable checkpoints retain their source qualifications:
- `6d2283d`: scoped setup candidate plus lazy outer producer preclaim, nonblocking original acknowledgement, stale admission neutrality and sticky actual consumer faults. 55/188/914/921 component/targeted/debug/Phase0 passes; 13 ART fixtures compiled. Push #545 and PR #546 subsequently completed all27 steps and274 decoded Android PASSED cases each, including13 setup cases. The historical pending observation remains preserved.
- `f9acdd8`: four literal account/model verification routes; 35/175/901/908 local cases. Push #543 and PR #544 independently completed all 27 steps and 261 decoded Android PASSED cases each.
- `477bda68df00e12c9866377364c728125b079941` ownership checkpoint: account/model five-child Native/Job/buffer manifest and local bounded response consumption. Push #541 and PR #542 completed 261 Android cases each.
- `4c6f758d6042b8b3cb401b894ac7107ca6009d82` anonymous descriptor prerequisite: push #539/PR #540 passed 248 Android cases each.
- `1213968` Native failure-wipe prerequisite: push #537/PR #538 passed 246 Android cases each.
- `63da8bb` bounded-cipher feasibility: push #535/PR #536 passed 245 Android cases each. Other earlier source qualifications remain in the evidence.

Recovery starts from exact verified `a8f64672c2017e5020631ba3453cd3a2a4f8a840`. **Original push #487 attempt 1 remains a genuine `:app:packageDebug` failure with unknown underlying cause.** Same-source attempt 2 passed; independent PR #488 passed. Available diagnostics do not establish OOM, storage, signing or another specific cause. Later #511 explicit heap failure is separate evidence. Earlier `193cd05` push #485/PR #486 successes remain preserved. Historical failures are retained; no tests/invariants were weakened.

Full Task 3 runtime/global factory/capability/immutable-copy/callee/provider manifests and combined capacity remain incomplete; scoped helpers do not accept complete pipelines. Production owned DIRECT stays denied before acquisition until complete cipher/staging/native validation integration is accepted. Tasks 4–8, permanent-signer and owner physical acceptance, and all 63 Phase 3 exit gates remain pending. See `docs/phase3/RUNTIME_MIGRATION_LEDGER.md`, `ENROLLMENT_DELETE_CHECKPOINT.md`, `PROBE_BUFFER_BINDING_CHECKPOINT.md`, `AI_SETUP_OWNERSHIP_CHECKPOINT.md` and preserved recovery/evidence documents.

Do not merge. GO requires independently satisfied final exact-head CI, security/regression evidence and every Phase 3 exit gate.
